summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) on June 17, 2026, disclosing a Director/PDMR Shareholding notice under EU/UK MAR. The filing reports the grant of options to the CEO and CFO under the Foundation Plan for Growth, a one-time co-investment plan to incentivise foundational work. Options were granted on June 16, 2026, at an exercise price of EUR 15.33 (USD 17.82, GBP 13.23). CEO Peter ter Kulve received 2,362,060 options. Vesting is 50% after three years and 50% after four years, subject to TSR performance relative to a peer group; exercise window extends to seven years from grant. Malus/clawback provisions apply. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
